THE PORTRAIT EDIT
ISSUE 01 / OCTOBER 2026
REFERENCE ARCHIVE
087
Behind the image
53 / Ivory Bloom
REFERENCE 5833.JPG / EDITORIAL PAGE 040
Art direction: Tonal ivory, sheer texture, floral appliqué, soft light and a stack of vintage papers on
the floor.
Full-length vertical fashion editorial of an original adult East Asian woman with long, wavy dark
brown hair, soft rosy cheeks and a calm, direct gaze, standing in a relaxed pose and holding a
pearl-beaded handbag filled with peach and yellow gerbera daisies. She wears a cropped ivory
mohair cardigan with small round buttons and handmade three-dimensional knit flowers, a
matching ivory knit mini skirt layered over a sheer, airy mohair maxi skirt with flower appliqués,
and white square-toe ballet flats. Pale warm-gray studio wall, soft gray floor with a diagonal
window-light pattern, a small stack of vintage papers in the corner, tonal cream palette, no text or
logos.
54 / Lilac Rosette
REFERENCE 5832.JPG / EDITORIAL PAGE 041
Art direction: Soft lilac against black hardware, sweet-meets-edgy contrast, clean studio
minimalism.
Full-length vertical studio fashion photograph of an original adult East Asian woman with long,
straight black hair framing her face, a soft natural expression and fresh pink lips, standing with her
arms relaxed at her sides. She wears a fitted lilac ribbed long-sleeve mini dress with a keyhole
neckline tied with thin ribbons and small fabric rosettes, a ruffled wave-shaped flower trim along
the hem, sheer white slouch socks and chunky black leather foldover boots with silver hardware.
Seamless pale gray-lavender backdrop, soft even studio light, muted pastel palette with black
contrast, no text or logos.
